data.one_liner: Dart bindings for Node.js core modules
data.what_it_does: Provides JavaScript bindings and utility functions for core Node.js modules, allowing Dart code to call Node APIs directly. It supports null‑safe Dart and exposes each Node module as a Dart library.
use_when: Building Dart applications that run on Node.js
Need direct access to Node core APIs from Dart
Migrating existing Node code to Dart
avoid_when: Targeting only web browsers or Flutter mobile apps
Using only high‑level Dart packages that abstract Node I/O
strengths: Comprehensive coverage of many core modules
weaknesses: Not all Node modules are bound (e.g., cluster, readline)
No high‑level abstractions for async patterns
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import the desired module, e.g., import 'package:node_interop/os.dart';
